notes.title: 📢 OUT NOW - 1.0 Release after Early Access!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

today is the day!!! The official release day of ✨Astral Tracks✨ in its 1.0 version after Early Access! ❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/ead5435e59a114567fe300404dff94f1ddb3afd4.png[/img]

In about a year in Early Access, we have learned, adjusted, changed, extended and improved the game to create the best experience possible. Check it out here on Steam and let us know what you think, share your thoughts and ideas – we are curious to hear what you think!

First, check out our brand new release trailer below:
[previewyoutube=DYWzToFweGU;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Regarding pricing:[/b] Although we added new features, updated the existing ones and fixed a lot of bugs, we decided not to change the price of Astral Tracks and leave it at 9.99 USD. After all, we want as many of you to be able to enjoy it! And we've also decided to go for a big launch discount to set a low threshold for you to try out the game and hopefully set some highscores ;-)

Before we get into what changed and what was added, we first want to say THANK YOU! Thank you to everyone who supported us during Early Access, either by playing the game, giving us feedback, liking our posts or otherwise supporting us as a completely independent studio self-publishing this game. We hope the new features and content will only enhance the experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/daca5023fa7779c12d14d97cdf85067c6f63a2aa.jpg[/img]
But let's get into the nitty gritty and have a look at what is new and improved in the 1.0 Release of Astral Tracks...

[h2]Change Log:[/h2]

[h3]New features & content[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Challenges[/b]: We added Daily, Weekly and Monthly Challenges to the game, each highlighting a specific track or several tracks from different stages and lengths. These Challenges should increase the level of competition and bring people together on the tracks. Additionally, the main menu was restructured to support the new layout of challenges. As rewards for ranking high on the leaderboard in the Challenges, we implemented virtual "trophies", which will be awarded to you after a Challenge has finished and can then be seen in the player stats.
[*] [b]Stage 3[/b]: We added a completely new stage with new level elements and new segments to the game. After playing a certain amount of tracks in the stage before, the new Stage 3 can be unlocked.
[*] [b]Track Decorations & Visuals[/b]: To make the world in Astral Tracks more vibrant and exciting, each track is now filled with planets, black holes, track pieces and more. The background of the tracks will "adapt" to the color of the sun or black holes. We tried to add a lot of variety to the different decorations and iterated over their spawn probability and combinations.
[*] [b]More Tracks![/b]: During Early Access, the game only had a limited amount of tracks in general, now lots of new tracks have been added to each stage.
[*] [b]Control Remapping for Gamepad/Controller[/b]: Added the option for control remapping for the gamepad/controller instead of only mouse/keyboard in the settings menu. 
[*] [b]Offline Mode[/b]: In order for players to enjoy the game also without an internet connection, an offline mode was implemented, which - while of course restricting e.g. up- and download of highscores - still allows you to access as many game features as possible.
[*] [b]Quick Play[/b]: No friend around to compete against? Try the new "Quick Play" feature to find a random, open multiplayer lobby and join it.
[*] [b]Track Timer & Next Match Timer[/b]: We added timers to the gameplay: The on-track timer starts in a multiplayer session as soon as the first player has reached the finish. This should give some more overview of your co-players as well as increase the competition and pressure! 😉 And the second timer, the Next Match Timer, starts in the track end screen as soon as one player has decided on an action (e.g. "Next" or "Rerun"). Then the other players get a time limit for also deciding on the next step, so the game can progress.
[*] [b]Co-Player Stats in the Lobby[/b]: In the PLAY menu, you can now hover over your character to get some player stats (trophies won, tracks run, ducks collected), and you get the same information about your co-players when inside a multiplayer lobby and hovering over their 3D characters!
[*] [b]Free Cam[/b]: Implemented as an internal tool, we decided to extend Astral Tracks with this "Free Cam" feature for everyone, which allows you to switch into a camera mode and move around tracks freely! You can access the Free Cam in the Spectator mode either via the pause menu while on a track or via the track end screen.
[*] [b]Lots more costumes and accessories![/b]: We added a loooot of new accessories to the game! Check them out in the Customize menu and tell us which one is your favorite!
[*] [b]Effects on co-players and ghosts[/b]: Up until now, players were only able to see the effects of their own character abilities (Dash, Grapple, Wallrun, and so on). Now, you can also see and hear the effects of ghosts and other players! This will make the tracks feel more alive and make multiplayer runs more fun!
[*] [b]Session Codes[/b]: When opening a multiplayer lobby, you can generate a Session Code that other players can use to join your game, if it is not possible to do so through your Steam friends list or through the (also newly implemented) Quick Play feature. This will also come in handy if we decide to bring Astral Tracks to other platforms in the future, too... 😉
[*] [b]More Achievements![/b]: We added a total of 5 new Achievements to the game, although we must admit that we removed one existing one for that... 😅 We took the existing "Getting a feel for it"-Achievement and split it up into 4 separate Achievements, one for each Stage (0, 1, 2 and 3), which should make obtaining them fairer. Aaaand we also added a new Achievement for the Challenges called "Multitasking", that can be unlocked by setting a highscore in all available challenges at the same time!
[/list]
[h3]Improvements / Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented an option to toggle the visibility of the track progress bar on and off during runs.
[*] Added descriptions for the newly added accessories.
[*] Made several adjustments to the different track filters and sorting mechanisms (known/unknown, played by friends, most highscores, and so on) for hopefully even better results
[*] Included additional people that worked on the game into the credits (one inside our team and translators)
[*] Updated the accessory menu, so that now if an accessory is unlocked they automatically adjust their state without having to leave the menu for it to update itself - this allows you to use a freshly unlocked accessory for one hand immediately on the other hand as well, where before you had to exit and re-enter the Customize menu once
[*] Updated the localization and made sure the game can now be fully played in all 10 available languages!
[*] Created a new trailer, new Steam assets and screenshots for the Steam page
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that started a track before it had fully finished loading
[*] Updated the Main Menu so that even during pop ups there is no controller input possible in the background
[*] In some instances, the loading of the duck transition screen didn't end and players were falsely able to open the pause menu, this should now be fixed
[*] The name for ghosts running the tracks should now always be displayed correctly
[*] Adjusted the implementation of the unlock requirements for the achievement "He was the #1", now players should only be able to unlock the achievement once they fulfil the right criteria
[*] Fixed a bug that the amount of tracks run and ducks collected under your name in the leaderboard didn't update, these numbers should now update live and without having to refresh a screen or go back to a menu
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing Escape during a duck loading screen froze the game
[*] Fixed a big where pressing R for Restart inside a Tutorial level resulted in characters not being able to move
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/1242134e22648bcf18086c7f248b72a3931bb5c9.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy the game! We would be happy if you leave a review, and if you liked it, recommend it to your friends!
And please feel free to share your thoughts, feelings and feedback in the Community Hub, or via our other social channels.

All the best and see you soon,
-LAB132

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello friends,

it’s us! We've been busy working on the full release of Astral Tracks, but it's about time that we give you an update on where we are in development and what you can expect.

But first of all - Astral Tracks is currently available for 20% off until Monday, 16th September! This is your chance to try out our game and help us improve it for the full release, if you've been hesitant until now 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/03c48905c7cb1ddd6c3d6c20f69ada1cecf8108d.jpg[/img]

Alright, the dev update...
Since the Early Access release of our indie game, we've been hard at work to polish up the existing features, like the different multiplayer modes, fine-tuned character abilities, improved the highscore system and of course fixed a lot of bugs. We also added new content like new accessories, new track elements and level decorations and new visual effects on the character.

But that's not all! It's important to have our game as good as it can be during Early Access already, but it's also very important to us to give you an (hopefully) even better game for the full release! We want to achieve that not only by making what exists better or more but also by adding completely new things.
There are several additions, changes and improvements coming your way for the full release, so let's highlight a few of them to give you some insights! 👀

[h3]Challenges[/h3]
One new feature that will be included in the full release are featured [b]Challenges[/b]. They highlight specific tracks and compilations of tracks prominently in the main menu, with the purpose of making your runs more engaging, bring players together on the tracks, and most importantly increase competition 🏁

[h3]Tracks & Accessories[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/69db1744edc126fcb3f3713f6d20e95cb6411048.jpg[/img]
We are also working on a completely new Stage to unlock! This new Stage will feature new level elements, bigger structures, will require other combinations of abilities, and thus will hopefully contribute to more variety in gameplay. And for even more content, we already have several new accessories for you in stock, that will hopefully make your experience even more fun and give you even more incentive to collect as many ducks as you can to unlock your very favorite hat, backpack or shoes 😁

[h3]...and more![/h3]
There are other things currently in progress that would go beyond the scope of this post. For example, we are looking into making Astral Tracks available on other platforms, and we are also working a lot on the background visuals inside the tracks with the goal of making the track environments more appealing and diverse!

Our small team does have its hands full, continuing on the road from Early Access to full release for Astral Tracks, as well as working on other projects, but not too full to say thank you for your support and following our journey! 

We are always supper happy and grateful to hear your feedback, comments and thoughts, so don’t be shy to let us know what you think, either in the Community Hub, or via our other social channels!

All the best, 
- LAB132 team

notes.title: Early Access Patch #06 - Update and Change Log
notes.content:
Hello dear friends of gaming! 🎮

1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and… [b]6[/b]! Once again we come with good news - a new patch for you, our 6th patch, and we are excited to show what we have in store for you! 🤩

All of this is happening while [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b] is still ongoing - but not for long anymore! So make sure to check out our indie game NOW while it's still on sale! 💲

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/ad476e6ee7e4bd30055dd98a256c1f5c5a141510.png[/img]
As probably everyone somehow involved in or with games knows, one of the most important things towards finishing a game, is fixing bugs! So while our previous patch included more new features and content, like the display of the 3D characters of all co-players in a lobby, new accessories and enhanced track filters, this patch focuses mostly on bug fixes! 🪲👀 And some nice improvements as well, of course, for example to the Steam Deck version and to the collectable ducks! You can find the full change log below! 

We are curious to know if you’ve previously found all the bugs we fixed and if you discovered even more?  Please let us know in the comments, in the Community Hub, or via our other social channels, and share your thoughts and wishes with us! What else you would like to see in future patches or in the full release? 💭💡

[h1]Full Change Log:[/h1]

[h2]Improvements / Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improvements to Steam Deck version: When playing on a Steam Deck, the game should now automatically start with controller mode instead of mouse/keyboard input, and the game should now also open up the Steam Input keyboard when focusing the "Seed" input field in the PLAY menu to enter a specific track seed
[*] Adjustments to collectable ducks on the tracks: Already collected ducks now have a different appearance and they do not follow your character anymore as if they were being collected again, collectable ducks now interfere less with the camera if there are lots of them following your character while being collected, the gold material of the collectable ducks was improved, and if there are lots of collectable ducks being pulled to your character there is a fade effect in place now so the screen isn't too cluttered
[*] Updated resetting your character with "Q" during a run, because it may have happened that the transition screen with the rotating duck wasn't shown
[*] Adjusted "Press Y to join splitscreen" text in PLAY menu, so it doesn't overlap with other menu text in certain languages
[*] Improved lighting in PLAY menu and brought the camera closer
[*] Adjusted player respawn points on some track segments as well as start and exit points of some segments
[*] Added more padding to description text of accessories (in detail view) in the customization menu and improved shadow casting
[*] Improved display of spinning duck as the currency on the lower left of (almost) every UI
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the track progress bar in multiplayer mode, which had some issues both with the icons in the lobby as well as with the individual progress of each icon on the bar on the lower right during a run - now, in the PLAY menu, all icons of players inside a lobby should be shown correctly on the lower right and while running a track, the icons on the progress bar should show steady progress whereas before it may have happened that they jumped around on the bar or the bar wasn't shown at all for client players
[*] When a host exits a track back to the main menu while playing multiplayer, all clients should now also be transferred to the main menu instead of getting a notification saying "Connection lost"
[*] In multiplayer, a client's character shouldn't turn automatically anymore when the host player turns their character in the customization screen, and client characters also shouldn't float above the ground anymore in the customization menu
[*] Fixed bug in the display of characters inside a lobby (freshly introduced in the 5th patch!), where characters and/or accessories of client players were sometimes displayed incorrectly or missing
[*] Characters shouldn't be tilted anymore after using a slide and then moving on the ground again without jumping first
[*] When joining a lobby as a client, the very first selection of ghost settings of the host should now be displayed correctly, whereas before they were only shown correctly once the host changed the settings at least once
[*] Updated implementation of the "Personal" and "Friends" track filters in the End Screen, which sometimes weren't working correctly before
[*] Fixed bug where players got stuck in infinite loading when they return to the main menu via the pause menu during the countdown of a track in singleplayer mode
[*] Fixed bug where pressing "F" in the customization menu, to change the color of your character or opening up the detail view of an accessory, sometimes wasn't working because of input focus issues
[*] Fixed dissolving effect on basket accessory, which was not spawned with the wanted effect when putting it on your character in the customization screen
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the updates and wish you a sunny day! ☀️
-The LAB132 team

notes.title: Early Access Patch #05 - Update and Change Log
notes.content:
Hello friends! It's that time again… - [b]PATCH TIME[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/29db09419033f0a8479add6f7e3fa2822fc4a009.jpg[/img]
We are happy to bring you the fifth patch for our game Astral Tracks! Our goal is to continuously improve and update our game while being in Early Access, so this patch includes a big improvement on the display of 3D characters when opening a multiplayer session, allowing you to see your opponents, as well as new accessories and visual effects, enhanced track filters and (as always) bug fixes. You can find the full change log below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/b502df20e1690703cf597e917a4e0d477bc9d52f.jpg[/img]
Please let us know in the comments or in the Community Hub what you think and what else you would like to see in future patches or in the full release!

[h2]Full Change Log:[/h2]

[h3]New Content / Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Included 3D characters of other players in the PLAY menu while being in a multiplayer session, so they are visible while waiting in a lobby to start a game
[*] Added Spectator mode to track end screens, so now you can spectate on your co-players while waiting for them to finish a track - Spectating was previously only possible in the pause menu
[*] Added five new accessories: [b]Bow[/b] and [b]Pitchfork[/b] for the hands, a [b]Quiver[/b] for your back, [b]Geta[/b] shoes, and an awesome [b]Feather Headdress[/b]
[*] Added one new music track, which gets dynamically played during tracks depending on your skills and the intensity of your actions
[*] Implemented a "personal" and a "friends" filter for the all time highscore list in the end screen of a track for more interaction with the leaderboard
[*] Added lightning between the golden spheres in the PLAY menu
[/list]
[h3]Improvements / Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Menu navigation should now also work by only using the keyboard
[*] Further improved procedural level algorithm to prevent it from creating colliding or overlapping paths and segments, where previously it had created tracks colliding with themselves on rare occasions
[*] Adjusted the credits and included all the translators
[*] A dissolve effect has been added to those accessories that didn't have one before
[*] While switching between menus the character is now correctly shown and hidden to give the illusion of being teleported
[*] Updated German localization
[*] Adjusted UI in PLAY menu: "Press Y to join Splitscreen" text has been moved up and positioning of "START" button has been changed so it doesn't get cut off by the platform anymore in certain resolutions
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the track filters "played by friends" and "not played by friends" so they properly check for tracks that actually have been played by your Steam friends or not - previously there was an issue with fetching the friend IDs on the server
[*] Fixed bug where players might have been able to pass through force fields while sliding
[*] Updated the collectable ducks that were sometimes falsely displayed in a track, after having finished a previous track
[*] Fixed bugs that accessories are not displayed after changing them or when changing from customisation to main menu
[*] Made changes to the track progress bar on the lower right of each track, to properly show the individual player progress and their icons - this was previously more prone to errors, resulting in icons jumping back and forth
[*] Fixed a few UI bugs like that "Connection lost" and "Lobby was closed by the Host" didn't appear at the correct time and the "Show Details" option was falsely displayed in the Settings sub menu
[*] When joining a lobby, now the ghost settings set by the host are displayed correctly
[*] Fixed bug where characters might get reset to the last checkpoint in the background of the end screen when finishing a track
[*] "NEXT" button in track end screen now makes sure the previous track isn't loaded again
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/6ce7129de8a2c8f47e6bf3f504c9e55f4bad6ca8.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy the updates and wish you a happy start of summer!
-The LAB132 team

notes.title: 📢 Astral Tracks is part of the Endless Replayability fest !
notes.content:
[h1]📢Astral Tracks is part of the Endless Replayability Fest, starting TODAY ! 🤯[/h1]

Being part of a Steam festival is always super cool, so we are very happy to announce that our indie game Astral Tracks is part of the Endless Replayability Festival, starting today! 🔄
During the festival, which runs for one week from today, May 13th, to May 20th, we offer Astral Tracks for -20% off - that’s the lowest discount we’ve ever done so far! 💸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/9f6e0ab9f5d4c47fb235a5f9ade429f1ed8a2b7b.jpg[/img]

Steam Endless Replayability Fest focuses on games that cannot only be played once, but over and over and over again because the playthrough is different each time. So after you get a taste of beating the game once or twice, you can continue to beat it a hundred, maybe even a thousand times! 💯

From the beginning, a part of the focus in the development of Astral Tracks was high replayability and trying to make each run different, with the goal to increase the fun of playing for hours on end. With that in mind, players can run racing tracks that are procedurally generated using a special algorithm, building together levels with pre-built hand-made pieces and following different rules. Each character can be dressed up with a wide range of accessories and, to make it even more fun, you can enjoy the game in either online or local multiplayer mode!

So take some time off, get the game NOW and prepare yourself for an Astral Track marathon, either playing by yourself or gathering some friends to keep you company! 👫

And if during those endless hours of playing you have thoughts and feedback, we would love to hear it in the comments, in the Community Hub, or via our other social channels!

We hope you enjoy the game and keep on playing!

Talk to you soon,
-The LAB132 team

notes.title: Early Access Patch #04 - Update and Change Log
notes.content:
Welcome back! How exciting that you are here! 😄

We come bearing gifts - the [b]4th patch[/b] for our game [i]Astral Tracks[/i]! This new update includes bug fixes, improvements for splitscreen and track filters, as well as enhancements to the customisation menu. You can find the full change log below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/7f200dc9d3f3bc42513c11d097d770e1d025fedc.png[/img]

And - in case you haven’t noticed 😉 - we also want to take a second to inform you that we’ve [b]updated [i]Astral Tracks[/i]' Steam page[/b] here as well! We created several [b]GIFs[/b] from gameplay or Engine-rendered footage to include in the “About this game” section. Don’t you also think it adds a lot more dynamic to the Steam page and thus reflects the game way better? 🤩

But coming back to the new patch...
The last update, patch number 3, included the new local multiplayer mode via splitscreen and we've continued to improve it ever since. Now when you enjoy the game with family and friends, sitting next to each other on the couch, it will only get better!
Additionally, we also worked on improving the track filters and sorting options. This will allow you to have better results when searching for tracks and filtering them.
We also enhanced the customisation menu, now allowing you to turn the character while trying on costumes and enjoy its beautiful accessories from all angles - I mean, have you actually seen all the awesome backpacks available? ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/3198f587a620f6331de06c991c8b6481f1abf821.jpg[/img]
Please let us know in the comments or in the Community Hub what you think and what else you would like to see in future patches! During Early Access, we are continuously working on improving the game and expanding the game for its full release, so stay tuned!

[h2]Full Change Log:[/h2]

[h3]New Content / Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Integrated the option to rotate your character in the customization menu
[/list]
[h3]Improvements / Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the in game UI sound volume, especially in the track end screen
[*] The credits screen in the pause menu is now scrollable while using a gamepad 
[*] While playing splitscreen, it now shows all players the same endscreen, resulting in a better overview and a less crowded screen
[*] While playing splitscreen, co-players now automatically enter Spectator mode when finishing if there are still co-players left on the track
[*] When playing multiplayer, ghost settings of the session host now automatically apply to all co-players
[*] Improved UI display of selected stages for co-players while playing multiplayer, automatically applying settings chosen by the session host
[*] Adjusted the character transition effect in the main menu, when coming back from a track
[*] Enabled transition effect for grapple hook of the astronaut character
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a track filter bug that prevented you from finding tracks with no highscores while filtering for "least highscores"
[*] Fixed lobby icons in the main menu so they don't appear twice in certain situations
[*] In the track end screen, the word "Next" is no longer cut off in some languages
[*] Fixed bug so that when playing multiplayer, co-players don't have a turned head or body after using the slides
[*] Updated the controller icons position throughout all menus
[*] Updated the buttons in the spectator mode, improving the spectating experience
[*] Removed faulty height fog from the sky in tracks
[/list]
[b]NOTE: [/b]We are still updating the games localization, so we ask for your understanding if we missed some translations in your preferred language! 🙏 Localization takes some extra steps and time, but we will make sure to update it as soon as we can.

The next patch will be a bigger one, so definitely stay tuned for that! We are working on some bigger, visible new features and hope to have them ready for you as soon as possible.

We hope you enjoy the updates and wish you a happy start of spring!
-The LAB132 team

notes.title: Early Access Patch #03 - Update and Change Log
notes.content:
Hello everyone - haven’t seen you in a while, looking good! ːguri_coolː

We’re really excited to update our game Astral Tracks with a third patch - and it’s a big one! We’ve got some major new features for you, new content, as well as improvements and fixes of course. You can find the full change log below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/faf22515ce962dc0604e6c23ab91c87bfd64809c.png[/img]

The biggest part is the [b]new local multiplayer mode via splitscreen[/b]! Now you can also enjoy the game with friends and family in real life - just set up some more gamepads, have them join the game and find out who is the fastest on the tracks! Next to that, there are also some cool new accessories available for you to try out in the Customize tab and new track filters for you to choose from, like sorting tracks from most highscores to least highscores or find tracks that have been played by your friends before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/492392a59677ff673fc27ccddf182ce652937a13.jpg[/img]
Please let us know in the comments or in the Community Hub what you think and what else you would like to see in future patches! During Early Access, we are continuously working on improving the game and expanding the game for its full release, so stay tuned.

[h3]Full Change Log:[/h3]

[b]New: Local splitscreen multiplayer![/b]
[list]
[*] Added local multiplayer mode via splitscreen! More players can simply join your game locally if you open up a lobby and have them join your session.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay & Tracks[/b]
[list]
[*] Pause menu now automatically opens up and pauses the game if the Steam Overlay gets activated during gameplay.
[*] Included “Restart” button into the pause menu to restart a track all over again (next to the existing shortcut: “R” on keyboard and “Y” on gamepad).
[*] Spectator Mode now stops spectating automatically when you open the pause menu while spectating.
[*] Added new track filter into the PLAY menu: You can now choose to filter tracks to find the ones your Steam friends have played before or haven't played before.
[*] Added new sorting mechanism to the PLAY menu: You can now choose to sort tracks from most highscores to least highscores (or vice versa) before starting. Depending on what setting you chose, you will first get tracks with a lot of highscores or very few highscores first and then more or less highscores progressively if you continue to press "Next" in the end screen.
[/list]
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Included 6 new accessories in the Customize menu:
    o Hands: Candleholder, Rolling Pin, Wand
    o Head: Colander, Steampunk Hat, Wizard Hat
[/list]
[b]Highscores & Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*] Display player names above characters (co-players, ghosts) while running tracks so you can see who you're up against and how experienced they are (number of completed tracks and ducks collected)!
[*] Added pop-up message informing players if the connection has been lost (only in English for now, more translations coming!).
[*] Added pop-up message informing players during multiplayer that the host of the session has closed the lobby (only in English for now, more translations coming!).
[/list]

We hope you had a good first few weeks of 2024, stay kind and healthy!

- The LAB132 team

notes.title: Winter Sale + Early Access Patch #02: Update and Change Log
notes.content:
Hello everyone and an early Merry Christmas! 

We are happy to announce that Astral Tracks is part of the Steam Winter Sale! Buy it now for 15% off and get ready to swing, slide, run, jump and grapple through the tracks! We are happy to hear your feedback and thoughts on the game. During this time of Early Access, we are continuously working on improving the game and adding content as well as features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/07f8f0dfd5ddf334e84308fcfdde561fb37d9ea8.jpg[/img]
And speaking of added content: The discount is not all! As an early christmas present, we are excited to release our second patch, including several new and fun winter-themed accessories - perfect for the upcoming holidays :wink: Now, you can customize your characters with cozy winter outfits and festive accessories!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/b8fc542d59f3981d7153e0d0ee090866eea63b3b.jpg[/img]
Full Change Log:
[list]
[*] Added 7 new winter- or christmas-themed accessories: Snow Boots, Candy Cane, Sparkler, Wooden Wand, Santa’s Backpack, Christmas Hat and Snowman Head (names are only displayed in English or German for now, translations will follow later)
[*] Integrated new effect for the characters when they die or (re)spawn, so they are dissolved and reassembled
[*] Look and location of BACK buttons in main menu is now standardized throughout all sub-menus[/list]
We wish you happy holidays and good start into 2024! See you next year with more patches and eventually the full release of Astral Tracks!

- The LAB132 team

notes.title: Early Access Patch #01 - Update and Change Log
notes.content:
[h1]Early Access Patch #01 - Update and Change Log[/h1]

Hi everyone,

today, we delivered the first patch for Astral Tracks in our Early Access phase!

We added 10 new accessories to the Customization menu for you to unlock, adjusted the grappling mechanic, updated translations, improved save game handling, performance in the main menu and gamepad support, and fixed several bugs in gameplay, highscores, and multiplayer.
You can find the full change log below!

We're looking forward to more of your feedback, let us know what you think and please don't hold back any suggestions for future updates ːguri_coolː

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/ca31add4d4b31496174c60a497b4a186bd66447c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/0a2b61b4b3e96c7b11e5699a90c10cc78eae852d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/cf1c86132e769e08bc9ca12b8ae19d26b362e970.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/e69c2799e65c5467b2191f6f688ec811df40da04.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/da89a0872efccb9abb3cac38b924c47dec149c0d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/0a56fe034a0342c8060193a9489a56377f21c3ce.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/d2d567c5ab06abf812766d7961f44ad463371afb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/eab7fe3c793566c3d38278719e85eac45b95fdc0.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/d1d2e78b664f90a47db71d8ed8666dbeacb70c4f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/7ee644736ccc44b4c4dfc7409b6ebf8a3954be61.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/038fd333b419c2fd4f1a66df9cc1ecf9ed644f3b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/46c1e11c62b87a2c8812aebdd703140407ff8d4d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/85d279f33c4c6bc3f3b005d0c776e6edd206991c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/410e1f8d8c74b2129e6d90f4d77ac6796219ec02.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/894866181867886f0d385fed53dd5c1a598d3d5e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/1ea4a5d53d16ea5577cd175881a0910c055faee7.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Full Change Log:[/h2]

[b]Game Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed GRAPPLE mechanic, so grappling is now allowed from any character state  this means grappling will now lift you off the ground instead of you having to jump or be in the air to start grappling
[*] Fixed bug with disabling grapple particles, where grappling indicator line was shown even though it was not possible to grapple
[/list]
[b]Gameplay & Tracks[/b]
[list]
[*] Rotated timers in some level segments
[*] Fixed bug, where no collectable ducks were displayed on the track when rerunning it through the corresponding input option in the end screen
[*] Fixed bug, where the deadly platforms had to be manipulated twice in a row with the EMP to properly reset their deadly state, after having fully reset a track using “R”
[/list]
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Included 10 new accessories in the Customization menu for Head, Body, Hands and Feet:
o Body: Fairy Lights, Lifebuoy
o Feet: Clogs, Duck Feet
o Hands: Balloon Dog, Plunger, Lantern
o Head: Pirate Hat, Shark Hat, and Umbrella Hat!
[/list]
[b]Highscores & Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved display of highscore in end screen if a track has been finished before, adding a + or – sign to the delta time to clarify if the new highscore is better or worse than before
[*] The ALL TIME highscore list in the end screen now ranks players without “skipping” ranks. The previous implementation had its focus on not displaying the same rank more than once throughout the CURRENT and the ALL TIME list, which seemed confusing after some more testing. The new implementation focuses on the ALL TIME highscore list, so ranks are in correct and complete succession there.
[*] Fixed bug, where it may have happened that two highscore were submitted for one run, because multiple finish times were marked by the game. The game now has several more checks and validations in place for the finish time before submitting it for the highscore list in the end screen.
[*] Fixed bug, where time and rank of a co-player in online multiplayer may have been continuously displayed as “pending” if said player has disconnected from the game
[/list]
[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] Made wallrun animation cyclic and loopable, so the animation doesn’t stop when wallrunning for a very long time
[*] Fixed issue with particle systems on accessories in the Customization menu, causing some particles to have the wrong size
[/list]
[b]More Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash in the highscore manager if a highscore has not been validated before accessing it
[*] Fixed potential issue in the saved track options, that prevented players from starting tracks
[*] Fixed bug, where characters may slide on surfaces after wallrunning
[*] Fixed issue with metal material that may have caused a faulty display of transparent ducks on the tracks that have already been collected in a previous run
[*] Adjusted zone on deadly platforms that kills characters, so platforms that are currently set to deadly cannot be climbed
[*] Adjusted staircase assets to make them seamless and fix potential issues with climbing mechanic
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] General improvements to Save Game, especially storage of chosen settings and user data
[*] Game now automatically pauses when a gamepad or controller is disconnected or unplugged
[*] Improved rendering time and performance in main menu and sub-menus by improving the animation of the duck on the lower left displaying your amount of in-game currency
[/list]
[b]General & Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated translations for all languages
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates! Until next time!
- The LAB132 team

notes.title: Announcement: Astral Tracks will release in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We have some news to share with you all. A while ago, we made the exciting announcement that we will release our competitive 3D speedrunning platformer [i]Astral Tracks[/i] for PC on the 16th of November 2023. 

After working very hard, and especially extra hard in the last months and weeks, and having participated in Steam Next Fest with an exclusive demo in October, we have already created a solid and fun indie game. But we feel like it would hugely benefit from more player feedback - yes, we mean you! - and a more community-driven approach.

So after careful consideration and evaluation, we have made the decision to launch [i]Astral Tracks[/i] on Steam in [b]EARLY ACCESS[/b] first. This decision was driven by wanting to create the best possible experience for players and although the development is really far, some things require more iteration and community feedback. Early Access will also give us more time to work on even more content! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44367915/aa99eff73a3a8cf0c7d9142e2ef4da07bd99c8db.png[/img]

We hope to gain a lot more insights and gather valuable feedback during the Early Access phase and then utilize it to make the game as awesome as we can for the full release!

The Early Access release will include a lot of the planned features like online multiplayer to play against your Steam friends, a big number of procedurally generated sci-fi tracks with different difficulty levels, and a great selection of customization options. To emphasize the competitive side of the game, players can set highscores to compare themselves on the leaderbords, compete against previous runs and ghosts, and also earn Achievements! Additionally, the game will be available in several languages upon Early Access release.

We really hope you will enjoy our game! Please let us know what you think, we would love to receive your feedback to build on your input and make the game even better. We will keep working hard on [i]Astral Tracks[/i], finalizing and continuously improving it, up until the full release.

So stay tuned for the 16th of November, put on those racing shoes and get ready to swing or grapple by next week for the Early Access release of Astral Tracks!

- The LAB132 team
